note: Reviewable proposals only. Promote into query-library.json via PR or --promote; never auto-merge. 10 entries that duplicated already-promoted query-library.json titles/views (PO TP, PO items, sales order items, billing documents, outbound deliveries, business partner, customer, supplier, journal entry items, G/L line items) were removed on 2026-08-13 — seed-query-proposals-from-usage.mjs should filter those out before writing this file next time.

entry.title: Cost centers
entry.description: Cost center master for CO reporting dimensions.
entry.select: ControllingArea, CostCenter, ValidityEndDate, ValidityStartDate, IsBlkdForPrimaryCostsPosting, IsBlockedForPlanPrimaryCosts, CompanyCode, BusinessArea

entry.title: Material document items
entry.description: Inventory movement item lines (goods movements) by material and plant.
entry.select: MaterialDocumentYear, MaterialDocument, MaterialDocumentItem, Material, Plant, StorageLocation, StorageType, StorageBin

entry.title: Production orders
entry.description: Production order header — plant, type, MRP controller, CO assignment (cost center, profit center) and planned/scheduled dates. Fills the Manufacturing (PP) gap; library had no production-order representation.
entry.select: ProductionOrder, ProductionOrderText, ProductionOrderType, ProductionPlant, MRPController, CompanyCode, ControllingArea, ProfitCenter, CostCenter, OrderPlannedStartDate, OrderPlannedEndDate, IsMarkedForDeletion

entry.title: Maintenance orders
entry.description: Maintenance order header — equipment, planner group, cost assignment and basic dates. Fills the Plant Maintenance (PM) gap; library had no maintenance-order representation.
entry.select: MaintenanceOrder, MaintenanceOrderDesc, MaintenanceOrderType, MaintenancePlant, Equipment, MaintenancePlannerGroup, ResponsibleCostCenter, ControllingArea, CompanyCode, MaintOrdBasicStartDate, MaintOrdBasicEndDate, CreatedByUser, CreationDate

entry.title: Inspection lots
entry.description: Inspection lot header — material, batch, plant, origin, quantities and usage-decision status. Fills the Quality Management (QM) gap; library had no inspection-lot representation.
entry.select: InspectionLot, InspectionLotText, Material, Batch, Plant, InspectionLotType, InspectionLotOrigin, ManufacturingOrder, InspectionLotQuantity, InspectionLotDefectiveQuantity, InspectionLotHasUsageDecision, InspectionLotCreatedBy, InspectionLotCreatedOn

entry.title: Fixed assets
entry.description: Fixed asset master — asset class, description, lifecycle status and acquisition data. Fills the Asset Accounting (FI-AA) gap; library had no fixed-asset representation.
entry.select: CompanyCode, MasterFixedAsset, FixedAsset, AssetClass, FixedAssetDescription, Currency, AssetLifecycleStatus, AccountIsMarkedForDeletion, Supplier, CreationDate, CreatedByUser

entry.title: Project/WBS elements
entry.description: Enterprise project (WBS) element — status, planned/actual dates and CO assignment (company code, controlling area, cost center, profit center). Fills the Project System (PS/PPM) gap; library had no project/WBS representation.
entry.select: ProjectElement, ProjectElementDescription, ProjectUUID, ProcessingStatus, PlannedStartDate, PlannedEndDate, ActualStartDate, ActualFinishDate, CompanyCode, ControllingArea, CostCenter, ProfitCenter, WBSElementInternalID
